name: Decisive Battles of WWII: Korsun Pocket
summary: Decisive Battles of WWII: Korsun Pocket is a turn-based strategy wargame that recreates the intense 1944 Eastern Front battle where Soviet forces encircled and attempted to destroy two German army corps trapped in the Korsun Pocket. Players take command of either Axis or Allied forces across a hex-based map, managing supply lines, unit readiness, command structures, and harsh winter terrain.
